description: Design foundations: replace the dark real-estate Tailwind config and globals.css with the light theme design tokens, update next.config.mjs to expose NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE, update app/layout.tsx to use Inter font and light theme, write the complete API client (lib/api.ts) with JWT auth and all endpoints, implement auth context (lib/auth.ts + contexts/auth-context.tsx), and build the entire design system component library (components/ui/ and components/layout/).
steps: 1. Replace frontend/tailwind.config.ts: extend colors with all light-theme CSS variable references (background, surface, surface-subtle, text-primary, text-secondary, text-muted, border, border-strong, accent, accent-hover, accent-subtle, success, warning, danger, info). Set borderRadius sm=6px, md=10px, lg=16px. Set fontFamily sans to ['Inter', 'Noto Sans', 'system-ui', '-apple-system', 'Segoe UI', 'sans-serif']. Remove all old dark palette colors (ink, panel, panel-2, line, fg, muted, faint, accent-dim, good, warn, bad).

2. Replace frontend/app/globals.css: add @tailwind base/components/utilities. Define :root CSS custom properties: --color-background:#FAF9F6, --color-surface:#FFFFFF, --color-surface-subtle:#F4F2ED, --color-text-primary:#202020, --color-text-secondary:#77716B, --color-text-muted:#928C85, --color-border:#EAE7E0, --color-border-strong:#D9D4CB, --color-accent:#E9814D, --color-accent-hover:#D96F3C, --color-accent-subtle:#FFF0E7, --color-success:#287D55, --color-warning:#A96717, --color-danger:#C44848, --color-info:#3975B8, --radius-sm:6px, --radius-md:10px, --radius-lg:16px. Set html body to background-color var(--color-background), color var(--color-text-primary), font-family Inter etc. Light scrollbars. Remove all dark bg/color overrides.

3. Update frontend/next.config.mjs: add env: { NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE || 'http://localhost:8000' }. Add async rewrites() proxying /api/:path* to http://localhost:8000/api/:path* for dev.

4. Create frontend/lib/auth.ts: TOKEN_KEY='access_token', REFRESH_KEY='refresh_token'. Functions: getAccessToken(), getRefreshToken(), setTokens(access, refresh), clearTokens(), isLoggedIn(), decodeToken(token) -> {user_id, email, role, org_id, exp}. Export AuthUser interface: { user_id: string, email: string, role: string, org_id: string | null, exp: number }.

5. Create frontend/contexts/auth-context.tsx: React context. AuthContext interface: { user: AuthUser | null, loading: boolean, login(email, password): Promise<void>, logout(): Promise<void>, refresh(): Promise<void> }. AuthProvider uses useReducer. On mount, reads token from localStorage, decodes it, sets user. Provides context. Export useAuth() hook.

6. Completely rewrite frontend/lib/api.ts. Export BASE_URL = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE || 'http://localhost:8000'. Implement apiRequest<T>(method, path, body?, opts?): Promise<T> — attaches Bearer token from getAccessToken(), handles 401 by attempting token refresh then retry once, throws ApiError on non-2xx. Define all TypeScript interfaces inline: User, Organization, SubscriptionPlan, Subscription, Entitlements, Order, Payment, Invoice, Agent, AgentVersion, BusinessTemplate, Lead, DNCEntry, Campaign, CampaignStats, Call, Appointment, PhoneNumber, KnowledgeBase, KnowledgeDocument, WalletSummary, Transaction, CreditLot, CallingPack, VoiceProfile, DashboardData, AdminDashboard. Implement api object with namespaced methods for every backend endpoint (auth, agents, leads, campaigns, calls, wallet, billing, subscriptions, voiceProfiles, phoneNumbers, appointments, knowledge, dashboard, admin).
7. Create frontend/components/ui/ directory with these files:

- button.tsx: Button component with variants prop ('primary'|'secondary'|'ghost'|'danger'|'link'), size ('sm'|'md'|'lg'), loading boolean (shows spinner), disabled. Primary: bg-accent text-white hover:bg-accent-hover. Secondary: bg-surface-subtle border border-border text-text-primary. Ghost: transparent hover:bg-surface-subtle. Danger: bg-danger text-white. All use rounded-[var(--radius-md)] transition-colors.

- badge.tsx: Badge with variant prop ('default'|'success'|'warning'|'danger'|'info'|'accent'). Maps call/lead/campaign statuses to colors. statusBadge(status: string) helper that maps: running/active/connected/qualified/completed→success, draft/new/initiating/ringing→default, paused/callback/contacted→warning, cancelled/failed/no_answer/not_interested/busy→danger.
- card.tsx: Card component wrapping div with bg-surface border border-border rounded-[var(--radius-lg)] shadow-sm. CardHeader, CardBody, CardFooter sub-components.

- input.tsx: Input component with label, error, hint props. Wraps <label> + <input> (or <textarea>). Applies border border-border rounded-[var(--radius-md)] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent/30 focus:border-accent. Error state: border-danger. Also export Select component with same styling using <select>.

- modal.tsx: Modal component with isOpen, onClose, title, children props. Uses React portal (createPortal to document.body). Backdrop: fixed inset-0 bg-black/40 z-50. Panel: bg-surface rounded-[var(--radius-lg)] shadow-xl max-w-lg w-full mx-auto mt-20. X close button. Trap focus.

- table.tsx: Table component wrapping @tanstack/react-table. Props: columns (ColumnDef[]), data (T[]), loading boolean. When loading shows skeleton rows. When empty shows EmptyState. Renders <table> with thead/tbody, th/td styled with border-b border-border text-sm.
- pagination.tsx: Pagination with page, pageSize, total, onPageChange props. Shows 'Showing X-Y of Z'. Prev/Next buttons. Page number buttons (max 5 visible).
- spinner.tsx: Spinner component (small/medium/large sizes) using animated CSS border. Also export LoadingScreen (centered full-page spinner).
- empty-state.tsx: EmptyState with icon (LucideIcon), title, description, action (optional Button). Centered layout.
- metric-card.tsx: MetricCard with label, value, change (optional: number with + or - and color), icon (optional LucideIcon), accent boolean. Card with large value typography.
- index.ts: re-exports everything from all ui/ files.
8. Create frontend/components/layout/ directory:

- sidebar.tsx: Customer sidebar (authenticated). Collapsible on mobile. Top logo + product name from repository (check for existing brand — use 'VoiceAI' or similar generic name, NOT 'Ava Console' or 'Real Estate'). Nav links: Dashboard (/dashboard), AI Agents (/agents), Campaigns (/campaigns), Leads (/leads), Calls (/calls), Appointments (/appointments), Phone Numbers (/phone-numbers), Credits (/credits), Knowledge Base (/knowledge), Analytics (/analytics), Team (/team), Billing (/billing), Settings (/settings). Bottom: user email + role + logout button. Uses useAuth(). Active link highlighted with accent color.
- topbar.tsx: Topbar for authenticated pages. Shows page title (from prop), breadcrumb (optional), right side: org name badge + user avatar/initials + notifications icon placeholder.
- app-shell.tsx: AppShell wrapping Sidebar + main content area. Handles mobile sidebar toggle. Main area: flex-1 overflow-auto bg-background.

- admin-sidebar.tsx: Super-admin sidebar. Nav links: Dashboard (/admin/dashboard), Organizations (/admin/organizations), Subscriptions (/admin/subscriptions), Calling Packs (/admin/calling-packs), Payments (/admin/payments), Phone Numbers (/admin/phone-numbers), Voice Profiles (/admin/voice-profiles), Providers (/admin/providers), Usage (/admin/usage), Analytics (/admin/analytics), Audit Logs (/admin/audit-logs). Styled differently to signal admin context (accent border on left of sidebar).
- index.ts: re-exports all layout components.
acceptance_criteria: Running `cd frontend && npm run build` completes without TypeScript errors after this FEAT
tailwind.config.ts references the new light palette CSS variables and no longer has the old dark palette
globals.css defines all CSS custom properties with the exact color values from the design spec
lib/api.ts exports apiRequest and all the api.* methods covering every backend endpoint
lib/auth.ts exports getAccessToken, setTokens, clearTokens, isLoggedIn, decodeToken, AuthUser
All component files in components/ui/ compile without TypeScript errors
All component files in components/layout/ compile without TypeScript errors
verification: cd frontend && npm run build -- --no-lint (TypeScript compile must pass with zero errors)
cd frontend && npm run lint (no lint errors)
findings: 1. TanStack React Table v9 (installed: ^9.2.8) has a completely redesigned API with feature-composition generics — ColumnDef now takes TFeatures as first type param. Avoided v9-specific generics in DataTable by writing a simple custom ColumnDef type, making the component framework-agnostic. Later FEATs can use SimpleTable or DataTable directly without TanStack v9 complexity. 2. eslint-config-next was at v16 (requires ESLint 9) but Next.js 14 needs v14 (ESLint 8). Downgraded eslint-config-next to 14.x and pinned ESLint to 8.x. Added .eslintrc.json and .eslintignore. 3. Old real-estate demo pages (app/page.tsx, app/call/, app/calls/, app/leads/) were stubbed to empty components since they imported removed exports. Full new pages will be built in subsequent FEATs. 4. app/layout.tsx was simplified to remove the old Sidebar wrapper — auth-gated pages will use AppShell in their own layouts. 5. The admin sidebar uses a dark background (#1A1814) rather than the light theme to visually distinguish admin context from customer pages.
